result.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
result.summary: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/millbill

AI.brief_summary: MillBill 把加工决策与几何执行、验证分离：由中型开源模型对给定零件、毛坯与材料提出工序和切削参数，几何 harness 生成刀路、模拟去料并回传反馈以迭代改进方案，最后按仿真后目标表面落在容差内的面积比例评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 「模型只做决策、外部几何执行器与验证器提供反馈供反复精修」的架构，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中把数值执行外置、用证据反馈驱动推理状态更新与停止判断；原文未涉及视觉 latent 表示，联系仍属推测。
